context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 113 verified Trading Bots (Phase 4). Backend endpoints: POST /api/bots (creates bot with enabled=false), GET /api/bots (list user bots), PATCH /api/bots/{id}/toggle (toggle on/off), DELETE /api/bots/{id}, POST /api/bots/webhook/{id}/{secret} (webhook receiver - no auth, uses secret), POST /api/bots/signal/process (requires auth). Frontend: Trading Bots accessible via user menu dropdown (data-testid='nav-bots-btn'). Panel has My Bots/Create tabs (data-testid='bot-tab-list'/'bot-tab-create'). Create form has 3 type buttons (create-bot-type-grid/signal/webhook), name input (create-bot-name), create button (create-bot-submit) that says 'Create Bot (OFF by default)'. Bot cards show toggle (bot-toggle-{id}), stats (trades/signals/pnl), and config summary. Webhook bots get a unique webhook_secret and can copy the URL. Grid bots run every 30s via APScheduler when enabled.
